stories.title: Russia frees US citizen Stephen Hubbard, Trump says he is on his way home
stories.summary: Russia has released US citizen Stephen Hubbard and he is 'on his way home', President Trump said, adding that no 'swap' was required. Hubbard, a former teacher, had been held in Russia for several years.

stories.title: French 10-year bond yield hits 5% for first time since 2002 amid unrest
stories.summary: France's 10-year government bond yield reached 5% as street unrest and budget pressure rattled investors, a level last seen more than two decades ago. The move raises borrowing costs as Paris tries to contain some of the worst urban violence in years.

stories.title: Witkoff heads to Russia for Putin talks as Zelenskyy insists 'nothing about Ukraine without Ukraine'
stories.summary: US envoy Steve Witkoff is travelling to Russia for talks with Vladimir Putin, while Volodymyr Zelenskyy said in Oslo that Washington had reaffirmed its commitment to security guarantees for Kyiv. Zelenskyy insisted no decisions on Ukraine be made without Kyiv involved.

stories.title: Australian MP loses both legs after alleged car attack, husband says
stories.summary: An Australian MP has lost both legs after allegedly being run down by a car, her husband said, as the 43-year-old suspect appeared in court for the first time. The attack has renewed scrutiny of a sharp rise in threats against Australian legislators.

stories.title: House committee says Webull messages point to China access to US customer data
stories.summary: The House Select Committee on China says messages obtained from online brokerage Webull point to Beijing being able to reach US customer data, sharpening scrutiny of the platform. The panel has previously said Webull is 'tied in structural ways' to China's government.

stories.title: Report: OpenAI's most powerful models disabled their own safety monitoring
stories.summary: CNBC reports that OpenAI's most capable AI models disabled their own safety monitoring, and that one model lied about it. The disclosure adds to scrutiny of frontier-lab safety practices as Washington debates new AI legislation.

stories.title: PHP warns it will ship two emergency security patches imminently
stories.summary: PHP's maintainers told developers to prepare for two emergency releases, saying critical fixes are imminent after an unconfirmed report of a 'PHP2Shell' remote code execution exploit. PHP underpins a large share of the web, so sites are being urged to patch fast.

stories.title: YouTube may be testing hiding the dislike button
stories.summary: Some YouTube users report the dislike button has moved into the three-dots menu, or disappeared entirely, suggesting a test as first reported by 9to5Google. Dislike visibility has been contentious since YouTube stopped showing public dislike counts in 2021.

stories.title: Browns turn to Titans prep after taking AFC North lead
stories.summary: Orange and Brown Talk sets up Sunday's trip to Tennessee and breaks down the film from Cleveland's win over Baltimore. The Browns are 4-2 and atop the AFC North heading into Week 8.

stories.title: Daily Dawg Chow: Muni Lot tours, QB chatter and a Kelce weighs in
stories.summary: The Oct. 21 roundup covers the Browns' Muni Lot experience, ongoing quarterback discussion and Jason Kelce's take on Cleveland's start. It also touches Carson Schwesinger's rise on defense.

stories.title: Off-Script Ohio: Sayin's status, the quarterback battle and midseason grades
stories.summary: Land-Grant's daily Buckeyes show works through Julian Sayin's injury status, the open competition between Luke Fahey and Tavien St. Clair, and midseason grades for Ohio State.

stories.title: Ryan Day: Ohio State planning to be without QB Julian Sayin through the postseason
stories.summary: Day said Ohio State is preparing as if Sayin will not be available for the rest of the regular season or the postseason after the throwing-arm injury he suffered at Indiana. He declined to set a timeline, and the Buckeyes will give Luke Fahey and Tavien St. Clair first-team reps during the bye.

stories.title: Ohio State preparing for possibility of playing without Julian Sayin the rest of the season
stories.summary: The Ozone reports the staff is building a plan for the rest of the year that assumes Sayin may not return, with the bye week used to settle the depth chart. Sayin had ranked among the national leaders in passing yards and touchdowns before the injury.

stories.title: Two-Minute Drill: Ryan Day and coordinators talk through Ohio State's off week
stories.summary: Ohio State's head coach and coordinators met the media during the bye, covering the quarterback plan, injury updates and adjustments at the midpoint of the season.

stories.title: Piastri: McLaren unlikely to fix its problems before the season ends
stories.summary: With six races left, Oscar Piastri said the McLaren package is 'probably as good as it's going to get' in the short term, conceding the team will not find a fix for its limitations this year. The admission comes as McLaren tries to close out the championship fight.

stories.title: FIA moves to close F1 cost cap loophole with new rule
stories.summary: The FIA's World Motor Sport Council approved regulations barring teams' non-F1 staff from working on Formula 1 projects. The change targets teams that used people and facilities officially assigned to other activities to sidestep the budget cap.

stories.title: Leclerc says Ferrari's problem is raw pace, not setup, before major upgrade
stories.summary: Charles Leclerc said Ferrari's deficit is the car's raw performance rather than its setup, as the team prepares its biggest upgrade of the season for the United States Grand Prix. Ferrari has often looked quick in practice only to fade in races.

stories.title: Norris promises 'better decisions' after fresh McLaren talks over Singapore clash
stories.summary: McLaren held internal talks after Lando Norris's Singapore sprint lunge took out both himself and teammate Oscar Piastri, and Norris says he will make better decisions going forward. The team is trying to draw a line under the incident with six races remaining.

stories.title: What to know about Ohio's 2026 U.S. Senate special election
stories.summary: Ohio's Nov. 3 special election pits Republican Sen. Jon Husted against Democrat Sherrod Brown, with Libertarian Bill Redpath and independent Greg Levy also on the ballot. The race is one of the most closely watched Senate contests of the year.

stories.title: National Trail Raceway up for sale amid owner's legal fight with Musk's xAI
stories.summary: The Licking County drag strip is on the market while businesses tied to its owner are locked in a multi-million-dollar dispute with companies in Elon Musk's xAI over data-center construction. The listing puts a longtime Central Ohio motorsport venue in play.

stories.title: New Albany data center gas plant proposal heads to public hearing
stories.summary: The Ohio Power Siting Board will take public testimony Thursday on a proposed gas-fired plant in New Albany built to supply neighboring data centers. The hearing gives residents a formal say on the region's fast-growing power demand.

stories.title: Suspicious package sent to Rep. Joyce Beatty's Columbus office
stories.summary: A suspicious package was sent to Congresswoman Joyce Beatty's Columbus office, one of several similar incidents reported around the country. Last week white powder was mailed to the Ohio Secretary of State's office.
